sessions.title: Critical Bug Fixes (Bugs 1-3)
sessions.smart_config: Role=CPS Post Expert | MODEL=opus | EFFORT=MAX | CONTEXT_BUDGET=40%
knowledge: Fusion 360 CPS API reference (createFormat, createOutputVariable, writeBlock)
sessions.intent: The three critical bugs that make the post produce broken G-code are fixed. Missing F words, NaN feeds, and the dead optimization engine all work correctly.

units.title: Fix Bug 1: Missing F word on facing/chamfer
units.description: Fix getFeed() line 19062 to return feedOutput.format(f) instead of raw f. Add forceFeed() call at start of facing/contour operations. Test with chamfer tool 2D contour.
exit_criteria: F word present on every G1/G2/G3 cutting move
Chamfer tool 2D contour produces correct F output
Facing operation first move has F word

abort_criteria: Any G1 move without F word

units.title: Fix Bug 2: prismEnabled → prismEnableIntelligence
units.description: Replace all 5 instances of getProperty('prismEnabled') with getProperty('prismEnableIntelligence'). This un-bricks the entire advanced feed optimization engine (stickout, chip thinning, axial depth, 3D adaptive).
exit_criteria: No references to prismEnabled remain
calculateOptimizedFeed returns non-1.0 factors when enabled
Stickout compensation activates for L/D > 4

units.title: Fix Bug 3: progFeed undefined in smart override
units.description: Define progFeed from section movement:feed parameter before use at lines 19896-19897. Test smart override mode produces valid clamped feeds, not NaN.
exit_criteria: Smart override mode produces numeric feed (not NaN)
Feed clamped within ±30% of programmed
No NaN anywhere in output

sessions.title: Precision Fix + Duplicate Consolidation (Bugs 4-6)

units.title: Fix Bug 4: Decimal precision — round at storage, format at output
units.description: Round prismOverrideFeed at storage (line 19908) to 4 decimal places. Ensure all physics multiplication chains pass through feedOutput.format() before output. Fix ijkFormat from 6 to 4 decimals for Hurco.

IJK values are 4 decimals
PRISM override feeds rounded at storage

units.title: Consolidate duplicate feed properties
units.description: Merge maximumFeedrate/prismMaxFeedRate into single max_feed property. Merge minimumFeedrate/minChipLoadFeed into single min_feed. Fix maxChipThinningMultiplier (1.5) vs per-tool (2.5) conflict — use per-tool value as ceiling, global as default.
exit_criteria: No duplicate feed cap properties
One clear max feed, one clear min feed
Per-tool chip thin multiplier actually reachable

exit_criteria: Zero duplicate var declarations
Zero dead properties
Zero dead functions
All descriptions accurate

sessions.title: Enhanced Material Intelligence
sessions.smart_config: Role=Materials Scientist + CPS Expert | MODEL=opus | EFFORT=MAX | CONTEXT_BUDGET=40%
sessions.intent: The post auto-detects material from Fusion's material library, looks up Kienzle constants, hardness, machinability rating, and applies physics-correct speed/feed adjustments without the user manually entering anything.

units.title: Material auto-detection from Fusion material library
units.description: Parse getGlobalParameter('material'), getGlobalParameter('material-name'), and getGlobalParameter('material-hardness') from Fusion. Build fuzzy matcher to resolve to ISO group (P/M/K/N/S/H). Add 40+ material presets with kc1.1/mc/SFM ranges.
exit_criteria: Unknown material → conservative ISO P defaults with WARNING

abort_criteria: Missing Kienzle constants for common material

units.title: Hardness-based speed derating
units.description: Implement HB/HRC-based Vc derating curve. Softer material (HB<200) → allow higher SFM. Harder material (HRC>45) → significant SFM reduction. Use published Sandvik/Kennametal correction factors.
exit_criteria: 4140 at 28 HRC uses baseline SFM
4140 at 40 HRC uses 70% of baseline
Aluminum ignores hardness (always soft)

units.title: Material-specific coolant strategy + surface finish hints
units.description: Auto-select coolant based on material: Ti alloys → mandatory flood + WARNING if mist. Aluminum → mist/air acceptable. Stainless → flood recommended. Add surface finish correction factors per material (ductile materials need lower feed for same Ra).
exit_criteria: Ti-6Al-4V with mist coolant → WARNING comment in G-code
6061-T6 with no coolant → no warning
316L Ra prediction accounts for BUE tendency

sessions.title: Enhanced Tooling Intelligence
sessions.smart_config: Role=Tooling Engineer + CPS Expert | MODEL=opus | EFFORT=MAX | CONTEXT_BUDGET=40%
sessions.intent: The post reads tool geometry from Fusion (diameter, flutes, flute length, corner radius, material, coating), calculates deflection limits, predicts tool life, and adjusts S/F based on actual tool capability — not generic lookup tables.

units.title: Tool geometry extraction + stickout intelligence
units.description: Read tool.diameter, tool.numberOfFlutes, tool.fluteLength, tool.bodyLength, tool.cornerRadius, tool.material from Fusion API. Calculate stickout ratio (body length / diameter). Apply progressive feed derating for L/D > 4 using beam deflection model.
exit_criteria: 12mm EM at 48mm stickout (L/D=4) → no derating
12mm EM at 72mm stickout (L/D=6) → 15-25% feed reduction
6mm EM at 48mm stickout (L/D=8) → 30-40% feed reduction with WARNING

units.title: Coating-aware speed adjustment
units.description: Detect tool coating from Fusion tool library (TiAlN, AlTiN, TiN, ZrN, DLC, uncoated). Apply coating-specific Vc multiplier: uncoated=1.0x, TiN=1.2x, TiAlN=1.5x, AlTiN=1.6x (for hardened), DLC=2.0x (aluminum). Add coating detection from tool description string.
exit_criteria: TiAlN coated → 50% higher SFM than uncoated
Uncoated HSS → baseline SFM
Unknown coating → conservative 1.0x with note

units.title: Tool life estimation + sister tool support
units.description: Implement simplified Taylor tool life: T = (C/Vc)^(1/n). Output estimated tool life in minutes as G-code comment per operation. Wire sister tool offset (T1→T21) with configurable life threshold. Add tool break detection subprogram call (O9800) after drilling/tapping.
exit_criteria: Tool life estimate in G-code comment for each tool change
Sister tool call when cumulative time > threshold
Tool break check after drilling operations

abort_criteria: Tool life prediction negative or >1000 min
Sister tool triggers on first use

sessions.title: Wire Kienzle Force + Power Limiting
sessions.smart_config: Role=Manufacturing Physicist + CPS Expert | MODEL=opus | EFFORT=MAX | CONTEXT_BUDGET=45%
sessions.intent: Every cutting move has a force prediction. When predicted force × cutting speed would exceed spindle power, feed is automatically derated. The machinist sees force/power values in G-code comments and knows the post is protecting their machine.

units.title: Embed Kienzle force calculation in post
units.description: Implement Fc = kc1.1 × ap × fz^(1-mc) directly in CPS. Use material kc1.1/mc from S3 material detection. Apply rake angle correction Kγ = 1 - 0.01×(γ₀ - 6°). Output force in operation header comment.
exit_criteria: Force output in header comment per operation
Correction factors applied for non-6° rake

units.title: Spindle power limit enforcement
units.description: Calculate P_kW = Fc × Vc / 60000. Compare against machine max power (configurable, default Hurco VM30i = 15kW). If P > 80% max → WARNING. If P > 100% max → auto-derate feed until P ≤ 95% max. Show power utilization % in G-code comment.
exit_criteria: Power shown as % of max in operation comment
>80% power → WARNING comment
>100% power → feed auto-derated + comment showing original vs adjusted

units.title: Torque limit at low RPM + deflection warning
units.description: At low RPM, torque (Fc × D/2) may exceed spindle max torque even if power is OK. Add torque check. Also add deflection warning when Fc × L³/(3EI) > tolerance/2.
exit_criteria: Torque warning at low-RPM heavy cuts
Deflection warning for long tools under load
Both warnings include suggested fix (reduce ap or increase RPM)

abort_criteria: False torque warning at normal cuts

sessions.title: Stability Lobe RPM Selection + Thermal Tracking
sessions.smart_config: Role=Dynamics Specialist + CPS Expert | MODEL=opus | EFFORT=MAX | CONTEXT_BUDGET=40%
sessions.intent: The post identifies chatter-prone RPM zones and automatically shifts to stable pockets. Thermal accumulation across operations triggers progressive derating. The machinist gets chatter-free first articles without trial and error.

units.title: Simplified stability lobe RPM check
units.description: Implement simplified SLD check: given tool natural frequency estimate (from diameter/overhang/material), flag RPM bands where N × z × 60 ≈ f_n (resonance). Suggest alternative RPM in stable pocket. Configurable on/off.
exit_criteria: 12mm 4FL at 30mm overhang, 8000 RPM → stable/unstable classification
If unstable, suggest nearest stable RPM ±5%
Comment in G-code shows stable RPM range

units.title: Thermal accumulation tracking across operations
units.description: Track cumulative heat input per tool across program. Estimate tool temperature from Vc × Fc × time. When accumulated thermal load exceeds threshold, derate speed 5-15%. Add dwell recommendation between heavy operations for thermal recovery.
exit_criteria: 5 heavy roughing ops on same tool → progressive speed reduction shown
Dwell suggestion after extended heavy cutting
Thermal state resets on tool change

units.title: Wear progression tracking + auto-derating
units.description: Estimate flank wear VB progression using simplified Usui model. Track cumulative cutting time per tool. Apply progressive feed derating: VB=0.1mm → 5% reduction, VB=0.2mm → 12%, VB=0.3mm → 25%. Show wear estimate in G-code comment.
exit_criteria: Wear estimate shown per operation
Feed reduces progressively with tool use
At VB=0.3mm threshold → strong WARNING about tool change

abort_criteria: Wear estimate grows without cutting time

Zero false positives on standard programs
